tools.name: search
tools.description: Search my essays, case studies, skills and ship log. Each match includes a passage and a source URL. Pass its page ID to fetch for the full page.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read a page in Markdown. Use its search result ID, path (such as /work/usdctofiat/) or URL.

tools.name: profile

tools.name: projects
tools.description: Find my products and their websites. Set with_mcp to true for products with their own MCP servers, endpoints and tool names.

tools.name: ship_log
tools.description: Read my releases and product milestones, newest first. Filter by project or start date.

tools.name: skills
tools.description: Find an astack skill for your coding agent. Each result includes its purpose, install command and guide.

tools.name: metrics
tools.description: Look up USDCtoFiat deposits, Peerlytics protocol deposits indexed and LLM tokens sold on tokensto.cash. Each figure has its own date.

tools.name: contact
tools.description: Get my email address and my profiles on GitHub, X and LinkedIn.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, contact · Private data: metrics, contact · Public sink: contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, contact · Private data: metrics, contact · Public sink: contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
